description: This file defines a TestServer class and a TestServerDispatcher class for managing test server lifecycle, including starting/stopping servers, handling test execution, and interfacing with external components in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TestServer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of the test server, including starting and stopping the server with specified options.

classes.name: TestServerDispatcher
classes.description: Handles communication with the test runner, manages test execution, and interfaces with external components for the Playwright test server.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the test server with specified host and port options.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the test server.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test server with given parameters, including serializer and stdio interception.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: A no-op method for pinging the server.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a file in VSCode based on provided location.

methods.name: resizeTerminal
methods.description: Resizes the terminal in the test runner.

methods.name: checkBrowsers
methods.description: Checks if browsers are available.

methods.name: installBrowsers
methods.description: Installs necessary browsers.

methods.name: runGlobalSetup
methods.description: Runs global setup for tests and returns report, status, and environment.

methods.name: runGlobalTeardown
methods.description: Runs global teardown and returns status and report.

methods.name: startDevServer
methods.description: Starts a development server for tests.

methods.name: stopDevServer
methods.description: Stops the development server.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the test cache.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files in the test project.

methods.name: listTests
methods.description: Lists tests in the project.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs tests with specified parameters.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Watches files for changes.

methods.name: findRelatedTestFiles
methods.description: Finds related test files for given files.

methods.name: stopTests
methods.description: Stops ongoing tests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the test server.

methods.name: closeGracefully
methods.description: Closes the test server gracefully.

methods.name: _setInterceptStdio
methods.description: Intercepts or restores standard I/O streams for testing purposes.
